== Description ==

A late-night group at a table after midnight at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, including [[Justin Miyashiro]] (left, black R2D2 T-shirt and glasses), [[Mike French]] (centre-right, grey zip hoodie over white shirt), and [[Matt Thornton]] (right, tan cap and black hoodie); remaining faces unlabeled.
